events.text:
Props placed to dress the existing filament rack without changing parts.

**Verification:** Four spool axles were verified with surfaces and each accepted a `filament-spool` (1kg) prop. Open top bins (`hex-bin-full-div3-x3` at level 2) were used for small tool props - two `heap-...-div3` small bins placed successfully.

Additional attempts to add more small tools hit configurator prop placement restrictions (`PROP_NO_REST` overlaps wall) - the tiny compartment bins only accept very small div3-size props, and not all tool props fit. Current dressing satisfies brief intent with spools on all axles and representative small printing workshop consumables in the bins.

**Issues:** `check_build` / `get_build` temporarily unavailable (hexAPI not loaded) after surface query, but prior `apply` outcomes confirmed all four spool props and two bin props are present and parts were not altered.
